sketch:
Observe: SVG schematic showing primary coil (N₁ turns) and secondary
coil (N₂ turns) linked by an iron core. AC source drives primary.
Voltmeters across both coils, ammeters in both. Sliders: N₁, N₂, U₁.
HUD: transformer ratio m = N₂/N₁; U₂ = m·U₁; ideal-transformer
relation I₂ = I₁/m (with a "P_out ≈ P_in" indicator when ideal).
Load resistor on secondary. Experiment: reach a target U₂ by choosing
N₂/N₁. Evaluate: U₂, I₂ readouts hidden; student picks the ratio
blind. Wrinkle: only the ideal transformer is modeled (no losses).
Live oscilloscope shows both waves are in phase and same frequency.
